posthoc_interventions.scope: Post-hoc success-conditioned interventions on reused final inputs; no new generalization estimate
posthoc_interventions.interpretation: No-goal-pulse still retains the static goal flag. Nonlocal ablation replaces radius>1 read values with zero, retaining read charges; it does not substitute local reads.
